findings: X11 key_state and pointer_button call Display.sync after each XTEST input. This is server synchronization, not application redraw acknowledgement.
Fixture log_event opens, writes and closes its events file synchronously inside the Tk event callback for each key press or button press.
The retained owner launches the fixture with --events under /mnt/c. Logging and effect writes share the Windows-mounted result directory.
No callback duration, application event timestamp or matched logging-disabled control was measured; logging causality and useful-feedback latency remain unknown.
